title: Qlik NPrinting Report Freshness SLA
app: Qlik NPrinting engine and scheduler logs via UF and the NPrinting API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:nprinting status="Completed"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by report_name
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>24
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Qlik NPrinting report and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A report can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Qlik NPrinting.
implementation: Ingest Qlik NPrinting success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical report exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of report by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Qlik NPrinting has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
